text: A further result by the same authors bears on a different construct and is kept separate from the two axes of §8.9. ✓ Choi, Zhu and Li (ACL 2026), *When Identity Skews Debate*, report that anonymizing the source of each response substantially reduces identity bias in multi-agent debate. That manipulation concerns the declared origin of a message rather than which model implements a participant, and it is therefore discussed under represented social source (§4.5.4) rather than under carrier heterogeneity.
